originality.rationale: Actual checked primary full text establishes marginal half measure, not same-phase inter-ratio vector independence. The entire dyadically characterized vector has a symmetry that yields full eventwise independence, a statement stronger than zero pairwise covariance; the exact nonzero obstruction makes the collection uniquely maximal. Known sawtooth gcd-integral covers the basic pairwise kernel and is not treated as independent novelty. Targeted mathematical literature and prior claim comparisons show no dominating same-phase collective theorem; remaining risk is an older implicit formulation.

value.rationale: The recent binomial-family gcd literature motivates inspecting simultaneous Kummer carries rather than individual valuations; the newer direct phase-function paper establishes marginal half-measure only. The result gives an exact and uniquely maximal class for which one central carry remains fair under conditioning on the whole vector, with a complete strict positive-correlation boundary for every other ratio. This distinction is structural and not a mere one-number or limited finite census. It informs the correct use of independence assumptions for multiple ratio restrictions, without asserting an unproved sieve asymptotic.
